newsitem.title: USA: Lone Star Steakhouse CFO backs 1997 EPS.
newsitem.headline: Lone Star Steakhouse CFO backs 1997 EPS.

text.p: Lone Star Steakhouse & Saloon Inc's Chief Financial Officer John White said he was comfortable with analysts' earnings per share estimates of $2.05 to $2.08 for 1997.

Speaking to Reuters after a presentation at the Montgomery Securities Hospitality Conference, he said he was also comfortable with analysts' operating cash flow projections of $120 to $125 million for 1997.
The company earned $1.63 in 1996 excluding the loss on the divestiture of a European joint venture.

Speaking at the presentation, Jamie Coulter, Chairman and Chief Executive, said the company, which currently has 231 restaurants worldwide, sees a 35 percent growth in total units in 1997. This would include 60 domestic Lone Stars, 10 international Lone Stars, six Sullivans and four Del Frisco's.
